note: Illinois DNR recreation area near Kinmundy, on 585-acre Forbes Lake. Oak Ridge Campground has three wooded loops above the lake; stairways, a boat dock and a 120-ft floating walkway lead down to the water and the marina. Many sites are short: about two-thirds take a 23-ft rig. The equestrian campground is separate, about 3 km south. --Claude
summary: DNR camp + park pages, 2027 fee schedule, ExploreMoreIL engine (all units) and imagery read. Base $11 was wrong for an RV: the only non-electric drive-in sites are six 5-8 ft tent pads, so base -> $28 (Electric) and the +$17 electric surcharge goes. 109 Class A 30 A sites; 72 of them 25 ft or longer (max 40), 37 shorter. Equestrian camp is a separate area ~3 km S (not a drop). Engine shows all three loops web-bookable vs the page's '52 sites'. Not waterfront kept.
